_comment: The offline half of the platform: a contract whose binding calls nothing. No host, no token, no network -- the engine runs a registered builtin. Pinned here because it is the one contract shape that proves the demo works with every upstream unreachable.

interface.name: estimate_delivery_window
interface.title: Estimate Delivery Window
interface.description: Estimates how many business days a shipment takes, from its destination zone and the chosen shipping speed.
whenToUse: The customer asks how long delivery will take before an order exists yet.
The merchant is comparing shipping speeds for a destination, e.g. 'how much faster is express to the UAE?'.
whenNotToUse: The customer is asking where an existing order is right now -- that needs an order tool, not an estimate.

zone.description: Destination zone relative to the store.
